unit.why: A quoted passage from the preface of Netiv Mitzvotekha describing R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotshov's habitual conduct (royal garments, royal meals of which he only looked at the food) and R. Elimelekh's mystical explanation of it; there is no single narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Separate from the preceding Besht tale and the following story about R. Yosef of Yampol.
